meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成新成员快速上手的入门指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要帮新成员快速上手项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate a quick-start guide for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're welcoming new teammates and want them up to speed fast.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要给新成员生成入职指南时，Claude 会读取项目知识图谱（若缺失则提示先运行 /understand），提取项目概览、架构分层、关键概念、学习路径和文件信息，输出一份 Markdown 入职指南，并提议保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md 和提交仓库。
howto.when: 当用户需要为新团队成员生成入职指南时触发。

say.text: 请为这个项目生成一份新成员入职指南
根据项目知识图谱写一份 onboarding 文档
say.note: 会包含架构分层、关键概念、文件映射等部分。

howto.what_en: When you ask for an onboarding guide, Claude reads the knowledge graph (if missing, prompts /understand first), extracts project info, layers, concepts, tour, files, and outputs a Markdown guide, offering to save and commit.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project.

say_en.text: Please generate a new member onboarding guide for this project
say_en.note: Claude will output a Markdown onboarding guide.

say_en.text: Write an onboarding document based on the project knowledge graph
say_en.note: It will include architecture layers, key concepts, file map, etc.

say_en.text: Create a team onboarding guide and save to docs/ONBOARDING.md
say_en.note: After generating, it will ask to save and commit.
